amendment_reason: P0-2: CW definition must use valid-start set membership, not [start,end] range interval. corridor_start/end are min/max of valid starts but intermediate steps may have gaps (recovery/abstain).

CW_correct_window.definition: teacher-positive AND emitted AND emit_step IN corridor_active_at_t

FE_false_early.definition: teacher-positive AND emitted AND emit_step < min(corridor_active_at_t)

LI_late_or_invalid.definition: teacher-positive AND emitted AND emit_step NOT IN corridor_active_at_t AND emit_step >= min(corridor_active_at_t)

mutual_exclusivity: CW, FE, LI, MP are mutually exclusive and exhaustive for teacher-positive episodes

k10_containment.definition: emit_step IN corridor_active_at_t (redundant with CW under valid-start definition)
k10_containment.note: corridor_active_at_t already requires [t, t+K-1] to not overlap release/recovery/abstain

timing.signed_error: emit_step - teacher_anchor (teacher_anchor = first stable_carry step + guard=5)

bootstrap_ci.method: paired/hierarchical per-fold: sample 50 episode IDs with replacement, retain all 3 seed results for sampled episodes. 10000 resamples, 95% CI.
bootstrap_ci.cross_fold: sample tasks/folds, then sample episodes within task, retain all seed results
